recipes.title: Tarka Dal
recipes.blurb: Comforting yellow lentils finished with a fragrant, crackling garlic-cumin oil drizzle.
steps: Rinse the lentils thoroughly until the water runs clear.
Simmer lentils with water, turmeric, and salt in a covered pot for 12 minutes until soft.
Whisk the cooked lentils lightly with a fork to create a smooth, creamy texture.
Heat the vegetable oil in a small pan over medium heat.
Add cumin seeds and let them sizzle for 30 seconds until aromatic.
Add sliced garlic and green chilli, frying until the garlic turns golden brown.
Pour the sizzling spiced oil over the cooked lentils, garnish with coriander, and serve.

recipes.title: Paneer Makhani
recipes.blurb: Silky, buttery tomato gravy enveloping tender cubes of fresh cottage cheese.
ingredients: 3 cloves garlic and 1 inch ginger, minced
steps: Heat oil in a pan and sauté the onion, ginger, garlic, tomatoes, and cashews for 10 minutes.
Cool the tomato mixture slightly, then blend until completely smooth with a splash of water.
Melt butter in the same pan over medium-low heat and pour in the smooth sauce.
Stir in the Kashmiri chilli powder, garam masala, and salt, simmering for 15 minutes.
Gently slide in the paneer cubes and simmer for 5 minutes to warm through.
Stir in the heavy cream, heat for 1 minute, and serve hot.

recipes.title: Goan Fish Curry
recipes.blurb: Bright and tangy coastal curry laced with rich coconut milk and warming spices.
ingredients: 250g firm white fish fillets (such as cod or sea bass), cut into chunks
steps: Heat coconut oil in a wide pan and sauté the chopped onion until soft and translucent.
Add garlic and green chilli, cooking for 1 minute until fragrant.
Stir in the coriander, turmeric, and chilli powder, toasting the spices for 30 seconds.
Pour in the coconut milk, tamarind paste, and 50ml water, bringing the sauce to a gentle simmer.
Season with salt and carefully place the fish chunks into the bubbling liquid.
Cover and cook on low heat for 6 to 8 minutes until the fish flakes easily.

recipes.title: Slow-Simmered Chicken Korma
recipes.blurb: Richly spiced, gentle yoghurt curry loaded with juicy, tender chicken pieces.
ingredients: 350g boneless chicken thighs, cut into bite-sized pieces
1 large onion, finely sliced and fried golden
20g blanched almonds, blended to a paste with a little water
3 cloves garlic and 1 inch ginger, grated
steps: Blend the fried onion, yoghurt, and almond paste together into a thick, uniform puree.
Melt ghee in a heavy pot over medium heat and sizzle the cardamom and cinnamon stick.
Add the grated garlic and ginger, sautéing for 1 minute until the raw aroma dissipates.
Add chicken pieces and cook for 5 minutes until browned on all sides.
Lower heat, stir in the yoghurt-onion puree, coriander, cumin, and salt.
Cover tightly and simmer on low heat for 35 minutes until the chicken is tender and sauce thickens.

recipes.title: Spaghetti Aglio e Olio
recipes.blurb: Pantry magic at midnight: sizzling garlic, olive oil, and fiery chili pepper.
ingredients: 2 tbsp fresh flat-leaf parsley, finely chopped
steps: Bring a large pot of salted water to a rolling boil and drop in the spaghetti.
Cook pasta until barely al dente, reserving one-half cup of the cooking water.
Gently heat olive oil in a large skillet over low heat and add sliced garlic and chili.
Cook until the garlic turns lightly golden and fragrant, taking care not to burn it.
Transfer the spaghetti directly into the skillet with a splash of pasta water.
Toss vigorously over medium heat until a glossy sauce forms, then stir in parsley.

recipes.title: Cacio e Pepe
recipes.blurb: Silky, peppery cheese dreams spun from nothing more than pasta and patience.
ingredients: 100g Pecorino Romano cheese, very finely grated
2 tsp whole black peppercorns, coarsely crushed
Fine sea salt for pasta water
steps: Boil pasta in moderately salted water, using less water than usual to concentrate starch.
Toast the coarsely crushed peppercorns in a dry skillet over medium heat until fragrant.
Ladle two splashes of starchy pasta water into the skillet with the toasted pepper.
Mix the finely grated Pecorino with a splash of warm water in a bowl to make a paste.
Transfer al dente pasta to the skillet and toss quickly to coat in peppery liquid.
Remove skillet from heat, stir in the cheese paste, and toss until a luscious cream forms.

recipes.title: Spaghetti alle Vongole
recipes.blurb: Salty ocean breeze in a bowl, kissed with white wine and garlic.
ingredients: 500g fresh clams, thoroughly purged and scrubbed
steps: Bring a pot of salted water to a boil and cook the spaghetti until firm al dente.
Heat olive oil in a wide skillet over medium heat, adding garlic and chili flakes.
Add the cleaned clams and pour in the dry white wine, immediately covering with a lid.
Steam for 3 to 4 minutes until the shells pop open, discarding any that stay shut.
Transfer the pasta directly into the clam pan along with a splash of cooking water.
Toss over high heat for one minute to emulsify the sauce, finishing with fresh parsley.

recipes.title: Classic Bolognese Ragù with Tagliatelle
recipes.blurb: Rich, tender meat sauce simmered slowly for Sunday-level comfort any day.
ingredients: Salt and black pepper to taste
steps: Warm olive oil in a heavy saucepan and sauté onion, carrot, and celery until softened.
Add the ground beef and pork, browning thoroughly while breaking up clumps with a spoon.
Pour in the white wine and simmer gently until the alcohol aroma evaporates completely.
Stir in the milk and a pinch of salt, simmering until mostly absorbed into the meat.
Add the crushed tomatoes, reduce heat to low, cover partially, and simmer for 60 minutes.
Boil the egg tagliatelle until al dente, drain, and fold gently into the rich ragù.

recipes.title: Garlic Stir-Fried Bok Choy
recipes.blurb: Crisp, emerald greens bathed in fragrant garlic for an effortless everyday side.
steps: Wash bok choy thoroughly and shake dry completely.
Heat cooking oil in a wok or skillet over medium-high heat.
Add sliced garlic and sizzle for twenty seconds until aromatic.
Toss in bok choy and stir-fry briskly for one minute.
Sprinkle salt, sugar, and water, then cover with lid for one minute.
Uncover, toss thirty seconds more until stems are tender-crisp, and serve immediately.

recipes.title: Tomato and Scrambled Egg Stir-Fry
recipes.blurb: Sweet, tangy, comforting eggs that taste just like a warm hug from home.
ingredients: 3 medium ripe tomatoes, cut into wedges
steps: Season beaten eggs with a pinch of the salt.
Heat one tablespoon of oil in a skillet over high heat.
Pour in eggs, scramble gently until barely set, then transfer to a plate.
Add remaining oil to pan, toss in scallion whites and tomatoes.
Cook tomatoes over medium heat until softened and saucy, about four minutes.
Stir in sugar, remaining salt, and soy sauce.
Return scrambled eggs and scallion greens to pan, tossing gently to combine.

recipes.title: Cantonese Steamed Fish Fillets
recipes.blurb: Silky, tender white fish finished with fragrant sizzling ginger-scallion oil.
ingredients: 1 thumb fresh ginger, cut into matchsticks
steps: Pat fish fillets dry and place onto a heatproof steaming dish.
Scatter half the ginger matchsticks over fillets and drizzle with rice wine.
Steam over boiling water on high heat for seven to eight minutes.
Discard accumulated steaming liquid and cooked ginger strips.
Top fish with remaining fresh ginger and scallion matchsticks.
Combine soy sauce and sugar, then spoon gently around the fish.
Heat oil in small saucepan until smoking, pour over aromatics to sizzle.

recipes.title: Red-Braised Pork Belly (Hong Shao Rou)
recipes.blurb: Melt-in-your-mouth glossy pork belly glazed in sweet and savory rich amber caramel.
ingredients: 400g pork belly, cut into bite-sized cubes
1 tbsp rock sugar or granulated sugar
steps: Place pork cubes in cold water, bring to boil, blanch two minutes, drain.
Heat oil and sugar in a heavy pot over low heat until melted and amber.
Add blanched pork belly cubes and stir quickly to coat evenly with caramel.
Add ginger, scallion knot, star anise, and pour in Shaoxing rice wine.
Stir in both soy sauces and warm water, bringing everything to a boil.
Cover, lower heat to gentle simmer, and cook for forty-five minutes.
Remove lid, discard scallions, and reduce sauce over high heat until glossy.

recipes.title: Nasu Dengaku
recipes.blurb: Sweet, savory broiled eggplant rounds that melt in your mouth with every bite.
steps: Score the cut flesh of each eggplant half in a light diamond pattern.
Heat sesame oil in a wide skillet over medium heat and place eggplant cut-side down for 4 minutes until golden.
Flip, cover the skillet with a lid, and cook for another 4 minutes until tender.
Whisk together the miso, mirin, sugar, and sake in a small bowl until smooth.
Brush the miso glaze generously over the scored cut surfaces of the eggplant halves.
Transfer under a hot oven broiler for 2 to 3 minutes until bubbling and lightly charred.
Garnish with toasted sesame seeds and serve warm.

recipes.title: Tamagoyaki
recipes.blurb: Sweet, fluffy golden rolled omelet layers made for a cozy morning breakfast.
ingredients: 2 tbsp water mixed with 1/4 tsp kombu dashi powder
steps: Beat the eggs gently in a bowl with dashi mixture, sugar, mirin, and soy sauce without creating foam.
Heat a rectangular or small nonstick pan over medium-low heat and lightly oil the surface with a paper towel.
Pour a thin layer of egg mixture into the pan and tilt to spread evenly across the bottom.
When the egg is half-set, gently roll it from the far side toward you into a log.
Push the rolled log back to the far side and lightly re-oil the empty pan surface.
Pour another thin layer of egg, lifting the cooked roll so the liquid flows underneath.
Roll the log over the new layer once set, repeating until all egg mixture is used.
Transfer to a plate, let rest for two minutes, and slice into bite-sized rounds.

recipes.title: Saba no Misoni
recipes.blurb: Tender simmered mackerel fillets bathing in a rich, deeply comforting ginger miso broth.
steps: Pour boiling water over the mackerel fillets in a colander to rinse away surface odors.
In a medium shallow saucepan, combine the water, sake, mirin, sugar, and ginger sticks.
Bring the liquid to a simmer over medium heat and stir in half of the miso paste until dissolved.
Place the mackerel fillets skin-side up into the simmering broth.
Cover with a drop-lid (otoshibuta) or parchment round and simmer gently for 10 minutes.
Dissolve the remaining miso paste directly into the broth using a ladle and cooking chopsticks.
Spoon the reduced sauce over the fillets and simmer uncovered for 3 to 4 more minutes until glazed.
Serve mackerel topped with ginger matchsticks and extra pan sauce.

recipes.title: Nikujaga
recipes.blurb: Sweet and savory simmered beef and potato stew full of classic home-cooked warmth.
ingredients: 150g thinly sliced beef chuck or ribeye
2 medium Yukon Gold potatoes (peeled and cut into chunks)
1 medium yellow onion (sliced into thick wedges)
1 medium carrot (peeled and cut into rolling chunks)
steps: Heat vegetable oil in a heavy-bottomed pot over medium heat and sauté the onion wedges for 3 minutes.
Add the sliced beef and cook briefly until it just changes color from pink to light brown.
Add the potato chunks and carrot pieces, stirring well to coat them in the rendered fat.
Pour in the water, dashi powder, sugar, mirin, and sake, then bring to a gentle boil.
Skim off any foam from the surface, reduce heat to low, and stir in the soy sauce.
Cover with a drop-lid or foil round and simmer quietly for 25 minutes until potatoes are fork-tender.
Remove the lid and simmer for another 5 minutes to reduce and thicken the sauce slightly.
Turn off the heat and let rest for 10 minutes before serving so the flavors soak in.

recipes.title: Nopales Salad
recipes.blurb: Crisp, tangy cactus paddle salad bursting with lime and fresh herbal sunshine.
ingredients: 2 tender fresh cactus paddles (nopales), cleaned and diced
steps: Bring a small pot of salted water to a boil and cook the diced nopales for 8 minutes until tender.
Drain the nopales thoroughly and rinse with cold water to remove excess cooking liquid.
In a medium bowl, combine the diced tomato, onion, serrano, and cilantro.
Add the cooled nopales, lime juice, olive oil, and sea salt.
Toss everything together gently and adjust salt before serving chilled or at room temperature.

recipes.title: Chilaquiles Rojos con Huevos
recipes.blurb: Crispy tortilla chips bathed in warm red salsa and topped with runny eggs.
ingredients: 2 dried guajillo chiles, stemmed and seeded
steps: Boil tomatoes and guajillo chiles in water for 8 minutes until skins split and chiles soften.
Transfer tomatoes, chiles, garlic, onion, and salt to a blender with 0.25 cup cooking liquid and blend smooth.
Heat 1 tablespoon oil in a large skillet over medium-high, pour in salsa, and simmer for 4 minutes.
Gently fold the tortilla chips into the simmering salsa until coated but still slightly crunchy.
In a separate pan, heat remaining oil and fry eggs sunny-side up.
Divide coated chips between two plates, top each with a fried egg, queso fresco, and crema.

recipes.title: Camarones a la Diabla
recipes.blurb: Juicy shrimp coated in a fiery, rich red chile sauce made for sharing.
ingredients: 0.5 pound medium shrimp, peeled and deveined
3 dried guajillo chiles, stemmed and seeded
steps: Toast guajillo and árbol chiles lightly in a dry pan for 1 minute, taking care not to burn.
Boil tomatoes and toasted chiles in water for 7 minutes until softened.
Blend tomatoes, chiles, garlic, onion, and salt with 0.25 cup cooking liquid until velvety smooth.
Heat vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the shrimp and sear for 1 minute per side until they just begin turning pink.
Pour blended salsa over shrimp and simmer gently for 3 to 4 minutes until sauce thickens.
Serve hot with lime wedges alongside warm corn tortillas or rice.

recipes.title: Tinga de Pollo
recipes.blurb: Shredded chicken slowly simmered in smoky chipotle tomato sauce for pure comfort.
ingredients: 2 canned chipotle peppers in adobo sauce
1 tablespoon adobo sauce from the can
1 medium white onion, halved and thinly sliced
steps: Place chicken breast in a pot with water to cover, bring to a boil, and simmer for 25 minutes until cooked through.
Remove chicken to a plate, let cool briefly, then shred the meat into thin strips using two forks.
Blend tomatoes, chipotle peppers, adobo sauce, garlic, and salt until smooth.
Heat vegetable oil in a deep skillet over medium heat and sauté sliced onion for 5 minutes until translucent.
Pour tomato chipotle puree into the skillet and bring to a gentle simmer for 5 minutes.
Stir in the shredded chicken and Mexican oregano.
Simmer uncovered over medium-low heat for 12 minutes until sauce reduces and chicken absorbs flavors.

recipes.title: Pad Pak Boong Fai Daeng
recipes.blurb: Sizzling morning glory with a savoury, fiery crunch in mere minutes.
ingredients: 250g morning glory (water spinach), cut into 3-inch batons
steps: Toss the morning glory, garlic, chilies, soybean paste, mushroom sauce, and sugar together in a large bowl.
Heat oil in a wok over the highest heat until smoking hot.
Dump the entire bowl of greens and seasonings into the center of the wok all at once.
Toss vigorously for 45 to 60 seconds until the greens wilt slightly while keeping their vibrant crunch.
Splash in the water around the wok edge to create steam, toss once more, and transfer immediately to a serving plate.

recipes.title: Pad See Ew Tofu
recipes.blurb: Chewy charred noodles tossed with savoury greens, crispy tofu, and golden eggs.
ingredients: 300g fresh wide flat rice noodles, separated gently
150g firm tofu, sliced into bite-sized batons
2 cups Chinese broccoli (gai lan), cut into 2-inch pieces
steps: Mix dark soy sauce, light soy sauce, mushroom sauce, and sugar in a small bowl.
Heat 1 tablespoon oil in a wok over medium-high heat, fry tofu until golden on both sides, then push to the side.
Add remaining oil and minced garlic, stir-frying for 15 seconds until fragrant.
Add Chinese broccoli and stir-fry for 1 minute until crisp-tender.
Push everything aside, crack eggs into the empty space, scramble lightly until mostly set, then fold into the greens and tofu.
Turn heat to high, toss in noodles and sauce mixture, spreading flat against the wok to char for 2 minutes before gently folding.

recipes.title: Tom Yum Goong
recipes.blurb: Zesty, aromatic broth teeming with plump prawns and fragrant crushed Thai herbs.
ingredients: 250g raw tiger prawns, peeled and deveined with tails left intact
2 stalks lemongrass, bruised and sliced into 2-inch sections
steps: Bring water or prawn stock to a rolling boil in a medium saucepan.
Add lemongrass, galangal, kaffir lime leaves, and shallot, simmering gently for 5 minutes to infuse the broth.
Stir in mushrooms and bruised chilies, cooking for another 2 minutes until tender.
Drop in the prawns and simmer for about 2 minutes until they turn pink and opaque.
Turn off the heat, stir in the fish sauce and lime juice, taste, and ladle into warm bowls.

recipes.title: Gaeng Massaman Neua
recipes.blurb: Rich, slow-simmered beef curry laced with aromatic spices, potatoes, and roasted peanuts.
ingredients: 1 medium waxy potato, peeled and cut into large chunks
1 small brown onion, peeled and cut into wedges
steps: Heat 100ml of thick coconut cream from the top of the can in a heavy pot over medium heat until oil separates.
Add Massaman curry paste and fry for 3 minutes until deeply aromatic and darkened.
Add beef cubes and toss to coat thoroughly in the paste for 2 minutes.
Pour in remaining coconut milk, water, cinnamon stick, and cardamom pods, bringing everything to a gentle simmer.
Cover and simmer over low heat for 45 minutes until the beef begins to tenderize.
Stir in the potato chunks, onion wedges, roasted peanuts, palm sugar, fish sauce, and tamarind paste.
Cover and continue simmering for an additional 20 minutes until potatoes and beef are meltingly tender, adjusting seasonings before serving.

recipes.title: Classic Spanish Pan con Tomate
recipes.blurb: Crispy toasted bread rubbed with juicy grated tomato and rich olive oil.
ingredients: 4 slices crusty sourdough or rustic bread
1 small clove garlic, peeled and halved
steps: Toast or grill the rustic bread slices until golden brown and very crisp.
Halve the tomatoes crosswise and grate the pulp into a bowl, discarding the skins.
Lightly rub the cut side of the raw garlic clove across the warm toast.
Spoon the fresh grated tomato evenly over each slice of bread.
Drizzle generously with extra-virgin olive oil and finish with a pinch of flaky salt.

recipes.title: Skillet Shakshuka with Feta
recipes.blurb: Gently poached eggs resting in a warmly spiced, bubbling sweet pepper sauce.
ingredients: 1 can (14 oz) whole peeled tomatoes, crushed by hand
1 medium red bell pepper, thinly sliced
Salt and freshly ground black pepper to taste
steps: Heat the olive oil in a skillet over medium heat and sauté the onion and bell pepper until soft.
Stir in the minced garlic, cumin, and smoked paprika, cooking for one minute until fragrant.
Pour in the crushed tomatoes, season with salt and pepper, and simmer for 10 minutes to thicken.
Make four small wells in the sauce and crack an egg into each well.
Cover the skillet and cook on low heat for 5 to 7 minutes until egg whites are set.
Scatter crumbled feta on top and serve hot straight from the skillet.

recipes.title: Crispy Pan-Seared Sea Bass with Lemon Herb Oil
recipes.blurb: Crispy-skinned fish fillets paired with bright, citrusy herbs and capers.
ingredients: 2 sea bass fillets (about 5-6 oz each), skin-on and scaled
Salt and freshly ground black pepper to taste
steps: Pat the fish fillets completely dry with paper towels and score the skin lightly.
Season both sides of the fillets generously with salt and black pepper.
Whisk together one tablespoon olive oil, lemon zest, lemon juice, grated garlic, capers, and parsley.
Heat the remaining tablespoon of olive oil in a nonstick skillet over medium-high heat.
Place the fillets skin-side down, pressing gently for 30 seconds to prevent curling.
Cook for 4 to 5 minutes until skin is crisp, flip, and cook 1 to 2 minutes more.
Transfer fish to plates and spoon the fresh lemon herb oil over the top.

recipes.title: Slow-Braised Greek Lamb Kleftiko
recipes.blurb: Melt-in-your-mouth tender lamb baked with oregano, sweet peppers, and lemony potatoes.
ingredients: 1 pound boneless lamb shoulder, cut into large bite-sized chunks
2 medium waxy potatoes, peeled and cut into chunks
1 green bell pepper, cut into chunks
1 small red onion, cut into wedges
Salt and freshly ground black pepper to taste
steps: Preheat the oven to 350°F (175°C) and prepare two large overlapping sheets of parchment paper.
In a large mixing bowl, toss the lamb, potatoes, bell pepper, onion, and smashed garlic together.
Pour over the olive oil and lemon juice, then season heavily with dried oregano, salt, and black pepper.
Transfer the entire mixture to the center of the parchment paper.
Fold and seal the parchment tightly into a closed parcel so no steam can escape.
Place the parchment parcel in a baking dish and bake for 75 to 80 minutes until meat is fork-tender.
Carefully unfold the parcel at the table and serve warm with its rich cooking juices.

recipes.title: Quick Garlic Sesame Dubu Jorim
recipes.blurb: Crispy braised tofu cubes coated in a spicy, savory garlic glaze.
ingredients: 300g firm tofu, drained and cut into bite-sized cubes
steps: Pat tofu cubes dry with paper towels to remove excess moisture.
Heat neutral oil in a nonstick skillet over medium-high heat and sear tofu for 6 to 8 minutes until golden on all sides.
Whisk together soy sauce, gochugaru, minced garlic, maple syrup, and 3 tablespoons of water in a small bowl.
Pour the sauce over the pan and simmer tofu for 3 minutes until the liquid thickens into a glossy glaze.
Remove from heat, drizzle with sesame oil, and garnish with sliced scallions and sesame seeds.

recipes.title: Classic Gyeran Jjim
recipes.blurb: Fluffy, cloud-like steamed eggs gently seasoned with scallions and sesame.
steps: Whisk the eggs thoroughly with water or broth, soy sauce, and salt until smooth and light.
Strain the egg mixture through a fine-mesh sieve into a small heatproof bowl or ceramic pot for extra fluffiness.
Stir in the chopped scallion and toasted sesame seeds, reserving a pinch for garnish.
Place the bowl into a steamer over boiling water, cover with a lid, and steam gently on medium-low for 10 to 12 minutes until softly set.
Carefully remove from the steamer, drizzle with toasted sesame oil, and top with remaining scallions.

recipes.title: Crispy Haemul Pajeon
recipes.blurb: Savory, golden seafood pancake loaded with fresh scallions and shrimp.
ingredients: 1 bunch scallions (about 8 stalks), trimmed and cut into 3-inch lengths
1 tbsp soy sauce mixed with 1 tsp rice vinegar for dipping
steps: Whisk together all-purpose flour, cornstarch, salt, and ice-cold water in a medium bowl until just combined into a light batter.
Fold the chopped scallions and shrimp directly into the prepared batter.
Heat the vegetable oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat until hot.
Pour the batter into the skillet, spreading ingredients evenly into a round disc.
Cook for 4 to 5 minutes until the bottom is crisp and golden, then flip carefully and cook for another 3 to 4 minutes.
Transfer pancake to a cutting board, slice into wedges, and serve alongside the vinegar-soy dipping sauce.

recipes.title: Slow-Simmered Dakbokkeumtang
recipes.blurb: Comforting braised spicy chicken stew with sweet carrots and tender potatoes.
ingredients: 500g bone-in chicken thighs, chopped into bite-sized pieces
1 medium potato, peeled and cut into chunks
1 medium carrot, peeled and cut into chunks
steps: Whisk together gochujang, gochugaru, soy sauce, mirin, minced garlic, and sugar in a small bowl to make the seasoning base.
Place chicken pieces in a medium pot, add water and the seasoning paste, stirring well to dissolve the sauce.
Bring pot to a rolling boil over high heat, then lower heat to medium, cover, and simmer for 20 minutes.
Add the potato chunks, carrot chunks, and sliced onion into the simmering pot.
Cover and continue cooking over medium-low heat for 20 to 25 minutes until chicken is tender and vegetables pierce easily with a fork.
Uncover, raise heat slightly, and simmer for 5 minutes to reduce sauce to a rich gravy, then garnish with sliced scallion.

recipes.title: Classic Provençal Ratatouille
recipes.blurb: Sun-drenched vegetables simmered slowly into pure melt-in-your-mouth comfort.
ingredients: Salt and black pepper to taste
steps: Heat two tablespoons of olive oil in a wide heavy skillet over medium heat.
Sauté onion and garlic until soft and translucent, about five minutes.
Add bell pepper and eggplant, cooking until softened for eight minutes.
Stir in zucchini, diced tomatoes, thyme, salt, and pepper.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and gently simmer for thirty minutes.
Uncover, drizzle with remaining olive oil, and simmer ten minutes more until glossy.

recipes.title: Traditional French Omelette
recipes.blurb: Silky, pale yellow perfection with a luscious, gently runny center.
steps: Crack eggs into a bowl and whisk vigorously with cream, salt, and pepper until uniform.
Melt butter in an eight-inch nonstick skillet over medium-low heat until foamy.
Pour in eggs and shake pan continuously while stirring rapidly with a silicone spatula.
When curds are creamy and barely set, smooth top and remove from heat.
Tightly roll omelette into an almond-shaped cylinder toward pan edge.
Invert seam-side down onto a warm plate, brush with residual butter, and scatter chives.

recipes.title: Moules Marinière
recipes.blurb: Sweet, briny mussels swimming in a fragrant shallot and white wine broth.
ingredients: 1 kg fresh mussels, scrubbed and debearded
Freshly cracked black pepper to taste
steps: Melt butter in a large heavy lidded pot over medium heat.
Add minced shallots and garlic, cooking gently for three minutes until fragrant.
Pour in white wine, season with black pepper, and bring to a rapid boil.
Add cleaned mussels all at once and immediately cover with tight lid.
Steam over high heat for four to five minutes, shaking pot occasionally.
Discard any unopened shells, stir in fresh parsley, and ladle immediately into wide bowls.

recipes.title: Poulet au Vinaigre
recipes.blurb: Tender chicken thighs bathed in a tangy, rich Lyonnais pan sauce.
ingredients: Salt and black pepper to taste
steps: Season chicken thighs generously on both sides with salt and pepper.
Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and sear chicken skin-side down for eight minutes until deep golden.
Flip chicken, cook four minutes more, then transfer to a plate.
Pour off excess fat, add shallots and whole garlic, and cook for two minutes.
Deglaze pan with red wine vinegar, scraping browned bits until liquid reduces by half.
Whisk in chicken stock and tomato paste, then return chicken to skillet with tarragon.
Cover, reduce heat to low, and simmer for twenty-five minutes until chicken is tender.
Transfer chicken to plates, whisk butter into hot sauce off heat, and spoon over.

recipes.title: Warm Spiced Ful Mudammas
recipes.blurb: Comfort in a bowl, perfect for tearing warm flatbread and scooping greedily.
ingredients: 1 can (400g) fava beans, rinsed and drained
steps: Combine rinsed fava beans, minced garlic, cumin, salt, and water in a small saucepan.
Simmer gently over medium-low heat for 7 to 8 minutes until beans are thoroughly heated and tender.
Use the back of a fork or potato masher to crush roughly half the beans into a creamy sauce.
Stir in the fresh lemon juice and adjust salt to taste.
Transfer to two shallow bowls and garnish generously with diced tomatoes and fresh parsley.
Drizzle with extra virgin olive oil and serve immediately.

recipes.title: Classic Shakshuka with Feta
recipes.blurb: Simmered spiced peppers and runny eggs make weekend mornings instantly magical.
ingredients: 1 red bell pepper, sliced into strips
Salt and black pepper to taste
steps: Heat olive oil in a wide skillet over medium heat.
Add the diced onion and bell pepper strips, cooking for 6 to 8 minutes until softened.
Stir in the minced garlic, cumin, and smoked paprika, cooking for 1 minute until fragrant.
Pour in the crushed tomatoes, season with salt and pepper, and simmer for 10 minutes until sauce thickens.
Use a spoon to create four small wells in the sauce and crack an egg into each well.
Scatter crumbled feta around the eggs, cover the skillet, and cook for 5 to 7 minutes until egg whites are set but yolks remain runny.

recipes.title: Pan-Seared Samke Harra
recipes.blurb: Zesty spiced fish bathed in garlicky cilantro sauce will wake up your dinner table.
ingredients: 2 sea bass or cod fillets (approx. 150g each)
Salt and black pepper to taste
steps: Pat fish fillets completely dry with paper towels and season both sides with salt and black pepper.
Heat 1 tablespoon olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat and sear fish fillets for 3 to 4 minutes per side until flaky, then transfer to warm plates.
Lower the heat to medium and add the remaining tablespoon of olive oil to the same skillet.
Add the minced garlic, cumin, coriander, and chili flakes, sautéing for 30 seconds until aromatic.
Stir in the chopped cilantro and lemon juice, cooking for 1 minute to form a bright pan sauce.
Spoon the warm sauce over the seared fillets, sprinkle with toasted pine nuts, and serve immediately.

recipes.title: Slow-Simmered Beef Kofta Tagine
recipes.blurb: Tender spiced meatballs bubbling in rich tomato broth are pure cozy perfection.
ingredients: 1 medium yellow onion, grated and juices pressed out
Salt and black pepper to taste
steps: In a mixing bowl, combine ground beef, grated onion, half the minced garlic, breadcrumbs, beaten egg, half the cumin, half the cinnamon, and 1/2 teaspoon salt.
Mix with your hands until uniform, then roll into 12 evenly sized meatballs.
Heat olive oil in a heavy-bottomed pot or tagine over medium heat and brown meatballs on all sides for 6 minutes, then transfer to a plate.
Add remaining garlic, cumin, cinnamon, and coriander to the pot, stirring for 30 seconds.
Pour in crushed tomatoes, season with salt and black pepper, and bring the sauce to a gentle simmer.
Return meatballs to the sauce, cover, and simmer on low heat for 35 minutes until meatballs are meltingly tender.

recipes.title: Avocado and Black Bean Skillet Tacos
recipes.blurb: Crispy warm tortillas packed with creamy avocado and zesty seasoned beans.
ingredients: 1 can (15 oz) black beans, drained and rinsed
steps: Warm olive oil in a skillet over medium heat and sauté minced garlic for 30 seconds.
Add black beans, cumin, chili powder, and a pinch of salt, cooking until heated through.
Lightly mash half the beans with a fork to create texture.
Warm corn tortillas in a dry pan until soft and pliable.
Fill each tortilla with seasoned beans and top with avocado slices.
Garnish with chopped cilantro and a squeeze of fresh lime juice before serving.

recipes.title: Stovetop White Cheddar Mac and Cheese
recipes.blurb: Pure nostalgic American comfort folded into a velvety, sharp cheese sauce.
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups sharp white cheddar cheese, shredded
Salt and freshly cracked black pepper to taste
steps: Boil macaroni in salted water until al dente, then drain.
Melt butter in a saucepan over medium heat, whisk in flour, and cook for 1 minute.
Slowly pour in warm milk while whisking constantly to prevent lumps.
Simmer gently for 3 to 4 minutes until the white sauce thickens.
Remove pan from heat and stir in dry mustard, salt, pepper, and shredded cheddar until melted.
Toss the cooked pasta into the cheese sauce until thoroughly coated and serve warm.

recipes.title: New England Shrimp Scampi
recipes.blurb: Plump shrimp swimming in rich garlic butter with a splash of white wine.
ingredients: 1/2 lb large raw shrimp, peeled and deveined
steps: Cook linguine in boiling salted water until al dente, reserving 2 tablespoons pasta water before draining.
Heat olive oil and 1 tablespoon butter in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add sliced garlic and red pepper flakes, cooking for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add shrimp in a single layer and sear for 1 to 2 minutes per side until pink.
Pour in white wine and lemon juice, simmering for 2 minutes to reduce slightly.
Stir in remaining butter, reserved pasta water, cooked pasta, and parsley, tossing well.

recipes.title: Classic American Meatloaf with Glaze
recipes.blurb: Tender homestyle beef meatloaf brushed with a sticky sweet ketchup glaze.
steps: Preheat the oven to 375°F (190°C) and line a small baking sheet with parchment paper.
Combine breadcrumbs and milk in a large bowl, letting it sit for 5 minutes.
Add ground beef, egg, minced onion, garlic, Worcestershire sauce, salt, and pepper to the bowl.
Gently mix ingredients by hand until just combined without overworking the meat.
Shape the mixture into two small oblong loaves on the prepared baking sheet.
Whisk ketchup and brown sugar together, then brush generously over both loaves.
Bake for 40 to 45 minutes until the internal temperature reaches 160°F (71°C), resting 5 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Classic Welsh Rarebit
recipes.blurb: Gloriously bubbling, tangy cheesy toast to banish any rainy day chill.
steps: Melt the butter in a small saucepan, stir in flour, and cook for 1 minute.
Gradually whisk in the ale until smooth and slightly thickened.
Stir in the grated cheese, mustard, and Worcestershire sauce until melted into a thick paste.
Remove from heat, let cool slightly for a minute, then beat in the egg yolk.
Toast the bread slices lightly on both sides under a preheated hot grill.
Spread the cheese mixture generously over the toasts, right to the edges.
Grill for 3 to 4 minutes until deeply golden, bubbling, and blistered.

recipes.title: Traditional Shepherd's Pie
recipes.blurb: Rich minced lamb baked beneath a craggy, golden mashed potato crown.
ingredients: 500g Maris Piper potatoes, peeled and cubed
Salt and black pepper to taste
steps: Boil potatoes in salted water for 15 minutes until tender, drain, and mash with butter and milk.
In a skillet, brown the minced lamb over medium-high heat, draining excess fat if necessary.
Add the diced onion, carrot, and garlic, cooking for 5 minutes until softened.
Stir in tomato purée, herbs, and red wine, simmering until the liquid reduces by half.
Pour in the stock, bring to a simmer, and cook uncovered for 20 minutes until saucy.
Stir in the peas, season generously with salt and pepper, and transfer into a baking dish.
Top with mashed potatoes, roughing the surface with a fork, and bake at 200°C for 25 minutes until golden.

recipes.title: Smoked Haddock Kedgeree
recipes.blurb: Fragrant spiced rice with flaked smoked fish and jammy boiled eggs.
steps: Simmer smoked haddock in milk in a shallow pan for 5 minutes until flaking easily.
Drain haddock, reserve 2 tbsp cooking milk, discard the skin, and flake the fish.
Boil eggs in a separate pot for 6 minutes, peel, and halve.
Melt butter in a skillet and sauté chopped onion and garlic until translucent.
Stir in curry powder and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add pre-cooked rice, flaked haddock, and reserved milk, tossing gently until heated through.
Garnish with parsley and egg halves, and serve warm with lemon wedges.

recipes.title: Mushy Pea and Mint Toast
recipes.blurb: Bright, comforting crushed peas elevated with zesty lemon on crunchy toast.
ingredients: Flaky sea salt and black pepper to taste
steps: Boil the frozen peas in salted water for 3 minutes, then drain thoroughly.
Heat olive oil in a small pan and gently sauté the shallot and garlic for 3 minutes without browning.
Add the drained peas to the pan and roughly crush them with a potato masher or fork.
Stir in the chopped mint, lemon zest, lemon juice, salt, and black pepper.
Toast the sourdough slices until crisp and golden brown.
Mound the warm crushed pea mixture generously onto the toasted bread slices.
Drizzle with a drop of extra olive oil and finish with a pinch of flaky salt.
